# Code of Conduct

This project follows the [Contributor Covenant 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct.html).

The code of conduct applies to repository issues, pull requests, reviews, discussions, and other project-managed collaboration spaces.

Be specific and technical when disagreeing. Harassment, discrimination, threats, or abusive behavior are not acceptable.

For conduct concerns, contact a repository maintainer through an available private channel or use GitHub's reporting and moderation tools. Do not disclose unrelated security vulnerabilities in a public conduct report; use the repository [security policy](SECURITY.md) instead.
